hĭĕrātĭcus , a, um, adj., = ἱερατικός,
I.belonging to sacred uses, hieratic: “charta hieratica appellatur antiquitus religiosis tantum voluminibus dicata, quae ablutione Augusti nomen accepit, sicut secunda Liviae, a conjuge ejus. Ita descendit hieratica in tertium nomen,” Plin. 13, 12, 23, § 74 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
